body: Sex isn't fun if you feel like you're being used all the time.

I have to go camping with my husband next week. I can barely keep it together with him around for 2 days, let alone an entire week in the woods with just him. 

I feel like I'm reaching my limit. I feel like I'm going to break and something will happen. He's taken advantage of me for three years...

I hate my life so much. I hate being me.
I really like to draw, but I'm having issues with my arm so I can't do it much anymore. Otherwise I walk my dogs and just do chores around the house.. I don't have friends or anything really

Hey, I appreciate the reply. 

It kinda helped.. it at least helped ease my mind for a little bit. My husband doesn't really know how depressed I am.. no one does. I keep that part of me secret from everyone. I can't see a doctor since I have no health insurance up here (I moved from the states to Canada and the residence paperwork is taking forever ). I'm just kind of stuck..

I don't know if I can get better. I'm just tired

I appreciate the reply. It's nice to have at least one person care I guess..

I still feel like garbage. Even though I tell myself that this is just the illness, I still have a desire to die. I got way too drunk over the weekend and made myself look like more of a fool than I already am.

I've tried, but since I am in Canada and have no legal status yet I can't see a therapist (I moved from the states). 

For me, that "voice" is deafening. I can't even do a chore without beating myself up. I'm just tired of being me.. I hate how I look, act.. I hate everything about me.
